in_hebrew.name: Erskine
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Spear of a wild boar
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Erskine הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ēorscan, meaning 'spear of a wild boar'. The name Erskine has historical roots in Scotland, where it was a surname for those who owned land associated with a wild boar.

in_greek.name: Erskine
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Spear of a wild boar
in_greek.long_meaning: Erskine είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English ēorscan, meaning 'spear of a wild boar'. The name Erskine has historical roots in Scotland, where it was a surname for those who owned land associated with a wild boar.
